You'd never expect a visitor from another star.
But in 2017, one raced past the Sun and sped up. What was it, actually?
Comets speed up by releasing gas. But ʻOumuamua had no visible cloud and no tail.
In 2023, scientists suggested trapped hydrogen, made by cosmic rays in its ice, gave it a gentle push.
Best guess. It's long gone, so we can't check.
